name: portki
description: A Bun-powered TUI for inspecting and safely stopping local port listeners.
author: Ricardo <ricardojparram@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.tsx --outdir ./dist --target bun --format esm --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/react --external @opentui/keymap
scripts.release:check: bun run check && bun test && bun run build && npm --cache /tmp/portki-npm-cache pack --dry-run --json
